{{Quote|There will be no compromise. You will surrender, or die.|Lassicar|<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" />}}
'''Lassicar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as an [[Imperial Guard]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]], [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and [[Galactic War]]. [[Reproduction/Legends|Born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Begeren]], Lassicar [[Death/Legends|killed]] his own [[Lassicar's parents|parents]] when he discovered they were part of a [[Begeren terrorist cell|terrorist cell]], and he was recruited into the Imperial Guard not long afterward.

A legendary Guardsman with a fearsome reputation, Lassicar was sent by the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] himself to stop the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] from retrieving the plans for the [[Emperor's Fortress]] on the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. However, Lassicar's attempts to trap the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] failed, and he was [[Mission to Hoth (Hunt for the Sith Emperor)|killed]] along with his elite Imperial Guardsmen [[Shock trooper/Legends|shock troopers]] in a battle with the Knight inside the wreck of the ''[[Star of Coruscant]]'' [[superdreadnaught]].

==Biography==
===Becoming a Guardsman===
{{Quote|I am a member of the Emperor's personal guard&mdash;as are the men under my command.|Lassicar|<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" />}}
[[File:SithEmblem-Traced-TORkit.svg|thumb|right|200px|The emblem of the reconstituted Sith Empire, which Lassicar would join]]
Lassicar was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] to [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Lassicar's parents|parents]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Begeren]],<ref name="Codex" /> which the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] [[Invasion of Begeren|conquered]] in [[3678 BBY]].<ref name="Blood">''[[The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 1: Shades of the Sith]]''</ref> When he realized that his [[Parent/Legends|parents]] were part of a [[Begeren terrorist cell|terrorist cell]] on the planet, Lassicar personally [[Death/Legends|killed]] them and exposed the cell to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Harvus]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire. The young man was then recruited into the [[Imperial Guard]], the ranks of which he rose through faster than any other Guardsman.<ref name="Codex" />

During his career as a Guardsman amid the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Lassicar personally killed six [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] as well as over two dozen [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] who earned the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] disfavor. A team of agents from the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], the Republic's intelligence agency, was sent to eliminate the Guardsman, but Lassicar killed them and shipped their bodies back to the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in a series of small containers.<ref name="Codex" />

===Mission to Hoth and death===
{{Quote|My patience is at an end. Lay down your weapons or my men will destroy you.|Lassicar, to the Hero of Tython and Leeha Narezz|<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" />}}
[[File:Guardsmen_Lassicar.png|thumb|left|200px|Lassicar threatens the Hero of Tython and Leeha Narrez on Hoth via hologram.]]
Around [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] selected Lassicar to lead a mission to the [[Water/Legends|ice]] planet of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. Lassicar and a group of Imperial Guardsmen were tasked with the capture of two [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]]: [[Leeha Narezz]] and the [[Hero of Tython]], who were both on Hoth to [[Mission to Hoth (Hunt for the Sith Emperor)|recover the plans]] for the [[Emperor's Fortress|Emperor's personal space fortress]]<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" />&mdash;though Lassicar was not aware of the specifics of the Jedi's mission.<ref name="The Imperial Guard">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Imperial Guard|Hoth}}</ref> Lassicar sent a number of Guardsmen [[Shock trooper/Legends|shock troopers]] to lay a trap for Narezz in the [[Highmount Ridge]], a geological feature on Hoth that was riddled with caves and also home to the wreck of the ''[[Deference]]'', a [[Pythar-class Imperial shuttlecraft|''Pythar''-class Imperial shuttlecraft]] that supposedly contained the plans for the [[Space station/Legends|station]].<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" />

Lassicar's men set up [[Turret/Legends|turrets]] in the caves and injured Narezz when she entered. Meanwhile, Lassicar had begun to negotiate the Jedi's surrender via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] when the Hero of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] arrived, destroying the turrets just before Lassicar's Guardsmen entered and leveled their [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] at the Jedi. However, Lassicar's attempts to force the Jedi to surrender failed when Narezz's reinforcements&mdash;a [[Fideltin Rusk's squad|squad]] of [[Republic trooper]]s under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Fideltin Rusk]]&mdash;abseiled into the cave. With the [[Squad/Legends|squad's]] help, the Hero killed Lassicar's men and secured the ''Deference''.<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" />

{{GameLS}}
Despite the setback, Lassicar remained committed to his mission. Upon learning that the Hero intended to storm the crashed [[superdreadnaught]] ''[[Star of Coruscant]]'', Lassicar took a contingent of Guardsmen shock [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] into the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] to head off the Knight. The Hero and a companion fought through many of Lassicar's men before encountering the Guardsman himself with a pair of subordinates, and Lassicar requested that the two surrender peacefully or suffer the consequences.<ref name="The Imperial Guard" />

However, the Knight revealed that the Jedi's mission was a distraction for Narezz to secure the station plans from the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], who had [[Thief/Legends|stolen]] them and stored them in their treasure cache in the ''Star of Coruscant''. When the Knight refused to surrender, Lassicar and his men engaged the Jedi and the Hero's companion in battle, but the conflict ended with the death of the Guardsmen.<ref name="The Imperial Guard" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Why take me alive? What does the Emperor want?''"<br />"''Even if I could answer you, I wouldn't. I serve my master's will.|The Hero of Tython and Lassicar|<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" />}}
[[File:Lassicar-Armor.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Lassicar was loyal to the Imperial Guard.]]
Lassicar was arrogant and supremely confident in the superiority of the Imperial Guard. He was also intensely loyal to both the Sith Empire and the Emperor, as he was willing to sacrifice his parents for the good of the Empire<ref name="Codex" /> and his own life in the service of its ruler. Lassicar's loyalty was such that he did not question the Emperor's instructions or inquire as to his reasons for capturing the two Jedi on Hoth.<ref name="The Imperial Guard" />

A [[Color/Legends|light]]-skinned individual, Lassicar had brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. He also possessed a number of scars along his right jaw.<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" />

==Skills and abilities==
As an Imperial Guardsman, Lassicar was highly trained in many forms of combat, and he was considered an incredibly deadly opponent, having killed a number of Jedi and several dozen Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lords]] during his career.<ref name="Codex" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|The soldiers you face are specially trained to kill Jedi&mdash;and they outnumber you.|Lassicar|<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" />}}
Lassicar wore the crimson [[Armor/Legends|armor]] of the Imperial Guard. While on Hoth, he forewent the uniform's crested helmet<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" /> and chose to wear his traditional armor instead of the white environmental gear that some of his subordinates used. In combat on Hoth, Lassicar favored a [[Vibrostaff/Legends|vibrostaff]].<ref name="The Imperial Guard" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:The_Old_Republic_cover.png|thumb|right|150px|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'', the game that Lassicar was created for]]
Lassicar appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]]. A major antagonist of the Jedi Knight-class storyline on the planet Hoth, Lassicar appears in [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] form in mission "Sub-Zero Showdown."<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" />

The final mission on Hoth has two possible paths: The first, "The Imperial Guard," has the player fight Lassicar and his men in the aft section of the ''Star of Coruscant'',<ref name="The Imperial Guard" /> while the second, "The White Maw," has the Jedi fight the pirate [[Zeshatt]] in the fore section. Whichever mission the player chooses, Sergeant Rusk will complete the other, but his squadmates will be killed against the highly-trained Imperials, and the Knight only goes after the White Maw out of vengeance.<ref name="The White Maw">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The White Maw|Hoth}}</ref> Therefore, this article assumes that the Knight allowed Sergeant Rusk to choose and that his squad survived, meaning that the player fought Lassicar.
